definitions.short: flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment
definitions.full: H906. bad I. בָּ֑ד בַּד, noun [masculine] white linen (derivation unknown) plural בָּ֑דבַּ֯דִּים אֵפוֺד 1Sam 2:18 (Samuel), 22:18 (priests of Nob), 2Sam 6:14 = 1Chr 15:27 (David): in P as material of different priestly vestments Exod 28:42 ; 39:28 ; Lev 6:3 (twice in verse); 16:4 (4 t. in verse); 16:23 , 32 . Plural (הַ)בַּדִּים (ה)לבושׁ clad in (the) linen garments , of angel Ezek 9:2-3 , 11 ; 10:2 , 6 , 7 ; Dan 10:5 ; 12:6-7 ,.
definitions.rootNote: perhaps from 909 (in the sense of divided fibres);
